sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: Financial gains are on the cards today, predicts Ganesha. Happiness will fly in as you receive some good news from an overseas friend. The evening promises rejoicing and relaxation, says Ganesha.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: Taurus, you hide your emotional needs from others. You need to be able to trust someone in order to share your feeling. They have to guess at your deepest secrets. Talk about it.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: Embrace nurturing exercises before starting the day, dearest Taurus, as the Leo Moon and Mars unite. These vibes boost endurance, and supporting yourself will only prolong the benefits you receive. Your household and family are due for some good luck, and you'll likely hear news worth celebrating as Jupiter and Venus rx activate. Actions taken in service of your own goals will also help you reach major milestones. Make the most of your downtime at home when Luna aligns with the nodes of fate this evening, indicating that a promotion or professional breakthrough could lead to increased responsibilities in the near future. Chiron sends soothing energy your way later tonight, so enjoy a healing meditation session before drifting off to sleep.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: Your enormous confidence and easy work schedule brings you enough time to relax today. Someone with big plans and ideas will catch your attention- Verify the credibility and authenticity of the person before making any investments. Family front could be problematic. Your negligence of family responsibilities may invite their ire. Your love story can take a new turn today, in which your partner can discuss the prospect of marriage with you. In this case, you must consider every aspect before taking any decision. Bold steps and decisions would bring favourable rewards. Today people will pass compliments-which you have always wanted to hear. Everything seems happy today in your married life.

readings.text: This is an excellent day to show your creative instinct. A sense of accomplishment should make you feel satisfied at work today. You’ve been working very hard. Therefore, your brain definitely deserves a break, feels Ganesha. Work on the projects that need your immediate attention and approval, says Ganesha.

Others are pressuring you with regard to your work. They are urging you to push forward when you are more inclined to take it slowly. Don't let other people take control of your work situation. Go at your own pace. Do things your own way.

readings.text: It is better to think twice before spending a huge sum. You should not take decisions blindly and should see to it that money is spent in right direction at right time. Forget unnecessary things for the time being.

You have energy directed toward groups, politics, and self-employment. You have all the friends and contacts you need to begin a new venture, whether product, service, or project at your current job. You will also meet new people who can help you get where you want to be financially. At the same time, you're augmenting and transforming your union with other people. You have all the tools you need to get ahead.

readings.text: A great day is on the cards, foresees Ganesha. This is the right time to attend work that is incomplete on all the fronts. With your energy levels moving upwards, you shall easily complete your tasks by end of the day.

Today's planetary energy may leave you feeling a bit melancholy. You may want to withdraw and have some quiet time for yourself. If you are saddened by any event in your family or even by scary global events, or feeling like you didn't accomplish what you wanted to during the past months, it would be helpful and purging to commit to some regular deep breathing exercises over the next few weeks.
